_doc: Sun, sky, fog and post effects, aimed at Rust's daytime Launch Site look (hard warm sun, blue sky, pale dusty haze) and judged in Gauntlet rounds against Rust captures. Colours are linear RGB 0..1. 'tuned' says how each value was set.

rows.note: sun elevation in degrees (negative points down): a low afternoon sun that sits inside the 'sun' Gauntlet view and throws long shadows
sun azimuth: 30 deg left of the 'sun' view (yaw 0), clear of the floodlight tower; behind-left of a player facing down the course, so ramps show a lit and a shaded face
warm desert sun
direct sun strength
metres of directional shadow; the course is about 380 m long
DirectionalLight3D angular diameter in degrees: softens shadow edges with distance (the real sun is about 0.53)
visible sun disc radius in the sky, degrees (a game-sized disc, larger than the real 0.27)
radius of the bright glow around the disc, degrees
glow strength around the disc, times the sun light
disc brightness, times the sun light (blooms with glow on)
sunlit cloud colour
colour of the thick, shaded cloud cores
fraction of the sky with cloud, 0..1
cloud size: higher is smaller clouds
clouds fade out below this sky height (sine of elevation) so the horizon stays hazy
sky colour overhead
pale, dusty horizon
sky colour just below the horizon
sky colour straight down
sky light fill
neutral fill mixed with the sky light so shaded faces read grey concrete, not navy
share of the ambient light taken from the sky (the rest is ambient_color)
distance haze
exponential fog per metre
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 Gauntlet r3: blind critics preferred the 0.0016 haze of 0.2.0 over 0.0024 and 0.0014

rows.note: how much the haze glows toward the sun
rows.tuned: 2026-10-09 world_r1 renders: 0.25 washed the sky round the sun white

rows.note: how much the haze takes the sky colour behind it (1 = distant hills fade into the sky with no grey band)
how much the haze covers the sky itself near the horizon
tonemap exposure (ACES)
contact shadows in corners and under rails
soft bloom on the sky and bright metal
